notes.title: Change Notes Feb 3rd
notes.content:
new feature:
- allow keyboard standlone play 
(added space to close dialogues, h for hints and allow numlock keys as alternatives for items)

fixes:
- prevent keeping the lightning staff longer by accident (which would block progress later)
- remove duplicate default staff in lake of the dead
